# chrome.scripting

Scripts and style sheets the extension puts into documents (src/page/ext_scripting.odin, ext_inject.odin; docs/extensions.md, section 3.6). A target is a tab and, in it, some frames or documents; each document must be one the extension has a host grant for, and none of Wren's own pages or another extension's. A script runs in the extension's isolated world of the document (ISOLATED), or in the page's own realm without any extension API (MAIN).

Gate: permission `scripting`; contexts: Background, Popup, Tab. Source: `api/ext_scripting.widl`.

## Methods and properties

| Member | Result | Status | Gate | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `executeScript(ScriptInjection injection)` | [InjectionResult](scripting.md#injectionresult)[] | host |  | Runs files or a function in the target's documents. The answer lists each document's result. |
| `insertCSS(CSSInjection injection)` | void | host |  | Adds a style sheet to the target's documents; scripts of the page do not see it in document.styleSheets. |
| `removeCSS(CSSInjection injection)` | void | host |  | Removes a sheet insertCSS added with the same text or files. |
| `registerContentScripts(RegisteredContentScript[] scripts)` | void | host |  | Content scripts matched against every document from now on, as the manifest's are. |
| `getRegisteredContentScripts(optional ContentScriptFilter filter)` | [RegisteredContentScript](scripting.md#registeredcontentscript)[] | host |  |  |
| `unregisterContentScripts(optional ContentScriptFilter filter)` | void | host |  | No filter: every registered script. |
| `updateContentScripts(RegisteredContentScript[] scripts)` | void | host |  | Changes registered scripts: what an entry gives replaces the registered script of its id. |

## Types

### ExecutionWorld

A string: `"ISOLATED"`, `"MAIN"`. `chrome.scripting.ExecutionWorld` names them.

### StyleOrigin

A string: `"AUTHOR"`, `"USER"`. `chrome.scripting.StyleOrigin` names them.

### RunAt

A string: `"document_start"`, `"document_end"`, `"document_idle"`. `chrome.scripting.RunAt` names them.
